Hi Samuel / Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. To make procurement and security intake as painless as possible, I want to run a short 30–45 minute intake session with your procurement, security, and an engineering representative. Goals: align on the PO/timeline expectations, gather required evidence (SOC2/retention/audit logs), and agree the mutual action plan so we can get Dedicated capacity reserved.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jan 13, 9:30–10:15am
- Tue Jan 13, 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed Jan 14, 11:00–11:45am

Attendees from our side: Marissa (account lead), Sergio (pre-sales SE), Grace (solutions engineering / onboarding). If none of the times work, share two preferred windows and we’ll adapt. I attached a draft mutual action plan and a procurement checklist to speed the intake.

Next steps: pick a slot and confirm attendee emails for procurement and security.

Thanks,
Karthik
